in_marathi.name: Devniransh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devniransh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devniransh is derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘Deva’ meaning ‘God’ and ‘Niransh’ meaning ‘gift’. This name signifies that the child is a gift from God.

in_bengali.name: Devniransh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's gift
in_bengali.long_meaning: Devniransh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Devniransh is derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘Deva’ meaning ‘God’ and ‘Niransh’ meaning ‘gift’. This name signifies that the child is a gift from God.
